property_summary: For every caller and burn amount, calling burn(...) on the correct contract never changes owner (owner remains the deployer); the mutant that removes the onlyOwner check allows a non-owner-triggered path (via an adversarial recipient that calls back into owned()) to change owner, so after burn the owner may differ.
change_summary: Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so owned() can be called by non-owner and set owner to msg.sender, changing resulting owner.
